description: Tellingen verkeerslichten 2014 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Utrecht. Dit is een overzicht van de verkeerstellingen in Utrecht uit 2014. Coverage: Gemeente Utrecht. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Utrecht. Its tags are telling, tellingen, verkeer, verkeerslichten, verkeerstelling. It offers 14 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2022-04-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
